description: Makes the Typeless voice dictation app usable with NVDA. Announces when dictation starts and stops, reads the floating status bar, keeps the last transcript and can read it back or copy it, names the unlabeled sidebar buttons in focus and browse mode, reads the stats and streaks while you Tab through the page, offers a list of all controls with clear names, and adds shortcuts to the main pages. Press NVDA+Alt+9 from any program to hear your stats. Experimental. Tested with Typeless 2.9.0. Interface messages are in Arabic.
